active_seconds_reason: No reliable active-reasoning versus tool/idle time telemetry available. Wall time only.
model_usage_reason: Per-agent model token meter not exposed. No estimated token savings asserted.

tool_calls.scope: This arm from first read through final metadata-writing call; parent/reviewer calls excluded.

packet_exposure_limit: The lower bound counts explicitly fully exposed original/actor text chunks, including the visible first 4000 chars of EO12815 actor context and the fully read alternate EO12696 text. It excludes all metadata, repeats, tool wrappers and truncated packet portions. Raw dossier read bytes are not model exposure. Exact total exposure cannot be recovered because four earlier displays were truncated.
serialized_char_metric_limit: Observed JS JSON.stringify result character counts, mostly escaped tool text, with an approximate 1450-character allowance for the initial read. This is not UTF-8 packet bytes or tokens.
